first.rationale: The onboarding decline is a direct, broad-based constraint on time-to-value, and prior evidence indicates simplification improved completion and early adoption. I would verify that evidence alongside promotional pricing and activation messaging before committing, with particular attention to qualified-revenue and retention outcomes rather than only early funnel lift. Promotional pricing addresses the competitive threat but may carry greater downstream quality and margin risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has confirmed evidence of +13% completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and +3% 30-day retention, making it the strongest fit for sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging is credible but showed a smaller retention gain. Promotional pricing is rejected because its +18% qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% retention decline and failure at first renewal.
